skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply Python programming concepts, including data types, control structures, functions, modules, and object-oriented programming.
Utilize Python libraries such as Pandas, Numpy, and Matplotlib for data analysis and visualization.
Develop problem-solving skills through Python programming exercises and projects.
Work effectively in teams to complete Python programming projects.
Demonstrate the ability to learn independently and apply knowledge to real-world Python programming projects.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and solve complex problems using Python.
Effectively communicate findings and solutions through presentations and reports.
